concepts.ready: Task dependencies/material/prep gates satisfied; not equivalent to assigned
concepts.eligible: Employee may execute per registry rules; visibility filter
concepts.assigned: Manager designated principal/coordinator on plan assignee field
concepts.claimed: Employee self-assigned via claim or start-from-available
concepts.participating: Employee has active or historical work session on operation
concepts.principal_operator: Optional coordinator; may be assignee/claimer; not exclusive owner
concepts.work_session: Individual time-bound work interval on an operation
concepts.help_request: Operational request for additional eligible coworkers
concepts.operation_progress: Aggregate completion state of the operation (not one person)
concepts.contribution: Individual participant output/time; separate from operation complete

separation_principle: coordonator/assignee != participanti efectivi != sesiuni != progres operatie
